featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother-in-law recently completed a Europe tour with Prachi Tours, and the experience was fantastic from start to finish.

The trip took place during a period of uncertainty because of the Iran conflict, but Saurabh handled everything exceptionally well. Despite the challenges, he kept everyone informed, and made sure the group felt reassured throughout the journey.

What impressed her most was how thoughtfully the trip was planned. Covering destinations like London, Paris, Amsterdam, Belgium, Switzerland, and Italy could have easily been exhausting, especially for senior travellers, but she never felt fatigued.
One of the biggest concerns for Indian travellers is food, and Prachi Tours got that absolutely right. The quality, variety, and consistency of the meals throughout the trip were excellent, which made the journey even more enjoyable.

Saurabh was present and approachable at every step, always ready to help, especially senior citizens and anyone needing extra assistance.

This Europe trip was a dream for my mother-in-law, and Prachi Tours made it truly memorable. I would highly recommend Saurabh and Prachi Tours to anyone looking for a well-planned, stress-free, and enjoyable Europe tour.

featured_reviews.name: Manasi Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thank you Nishnai team, Aniket, Praveen, Sanika, Babubhai, & Pallavi for giving us the opportunity to visit and explore Rajasthan - Jodhpur and Jaisalmer and making our tour successful.  This was my 2nd trip with Nishnai Holidays.  The tour started with travelling via Suryanagari Express on 5 March 2026.   I joined the tour as a solo traveler but met a group of friendly people.  Everyone seemed energetic and excited about tour; had been making reels, playing antakshari, dancing on Music.  At Jodhpur, we visited Mehrangarh Fort, Museum, other places, and explored local market best known for handcrafts.   The guides provided us the facts, the historical information about the places.  At Jaisalmer, we visited Sonar fort, Patwon ki Haveli and explored many antique things including utensils, gramophone, telephone, furniture, kerosene fridge, etc.  We visited Bada Bagh, and kuldhara village and learned the history behind its curse.  We enjoyed sam dunes, tent stay, camel ride, Rajasthani cultural program, music, and dinner.   The meals were good along with chaas and desserts.  All hotel rooms were clean, spacious, and royal with good water supply and geyser and AC facility.   Transport AC bus was excellent. I enjoyed the tour and Womens Day celebration with cake, games, reels, and lots of fun.
💯 Value for money.
💯 recommended

Such disciplined execution reflects the experience and commitment of your team.

It is often the small details that make a journey comfortable, and your team ensured that every such detail was taken care of. The transportation, accommodation, and overall logistics were equally commendable and contributed significantly to the pleasant experience.

Beyond the arrangements, what truly stood out was the warmth, care, and personal attention shown by the tour managers and support staff. Their willingness to help, guide, and assist participants at every step created a sense of comfort and trust among the group members. Such dedication transforms a tour from being merely a journey into a memorable experience.

This pilgrimage provided not only spiritual fulfillment but also the opportunity to travel in a well-organized, friendly, and harmonious environment. I returned home with wonderful memories, a sense of peace, and immense appreciation for the efforts put in by the entire Nishnai team.

Please convey my heartfelt thanks to Ms. Rudra, Mr. Aniket, and everyone involved in making this tour such a grand success. I wish Nishnai Group continued success in organizing many more memorable journeys, and I look forward to joining your future tours.
